intent.population: The total labor force, without claiming specific age, sex or household coverage.
intent.measurement: Annual unemployment share of total labor force, in percent, using the modeled ILO estimate.
intent.exclusions: Use the stated unemployment conditions: without work, available for work and seeking employment; make no additional inclusion claims.
